insights.summary: Fabory UK has sent a fastener declaration of compliance (F2.1 to EN ISO 16228:2017) covering a delivery against our PO 21664-180926, their order 431086492, pack list 32052039. It lists four fastener lines (M5 and M6 flat washers, M8x30 hex screws, M8x16 A2 hex screws) with batch numbers and quantities. No action is requested; it is a compliance document accompanying goods.
